admin.emailDeliveryHint: manual: you copy the link yourself. smtp: your own mail server, configured below. relay: the kroma.tv relay, which carries what this server writes once you have allowed this server there.
admin.emailDesc: How reset and verification links reach your users. The one-time code never travels by email: read it to the user yourself.
admin.relayTestAsked: The relay is reachable and this server is registered. Nobody has allowed it to send yet, so the relay’s question went to {email}: open it, check the server’s host and IP, click Allow, then test again to see a delivery.
admin.relayTestDisabled: Choose the kroma.tv relay above first.
admin.relayTestHint: Registers this server with the relay and sends a test email to your own address. The first time, your address receives the relay’s question instead: allow this server in it, then test again.
admin.relayTestNoAddress: Set a public address first (Remote access): the relay binds this server to it.
admin.smtpEnabledHint: The server hands reset and verification emails to this SMTP server.
admin.smtpFromHint: The sender your users see, e.g. kroma@yourdomain.tld.
admin.smtpPasswordHint: Stored on this server only, never shown again.
admin.smtpTestDisabled: Choose your own mail server above first.
admin.smtpTestHint: Sends a test email to your own address with the saved settings.
admin.verificationInactive: The kroma.tv relay has not been allowed for this server yet, so nothing was emailed: copy the link yourself, or run the relay test in Settings to allow it.
admin.verificationManual: No delivery configured: copy the link and deliver it yourself.
admin.verificationRefused: This address is closed to this server on the kroma.tv relay (it opted out, bounced, or reported it): copy the link yourself.
